# Awesome Gemini 4 Carbon

Every Gemini 4 Carbon creation worth seeing, each with its exact prompt, the original post and an Opus 5.5 side-by-side.

![Gemini 4 Carbon curated prompt card: 9 creations · 8 authors credited · every link checked 2026-10-29](assets/social-preview.png)

**9 creations · 8 authors credited · every link checked 2026-10-29**

That line is generated from [`data/entries.yml`](data/entries.yml): one row per creation, counting the poster and anyone the poster names.

Public creations whose authors attribute them to Gemini 4 Carbon. Each row quotes the prompt only as that author published it, names them, and links the original post. Where someone published an Opus 5.5 output from that same prompt, the row links it.

Google announced Carbon on 2026-10-28 and limited the first rollout to cyber defenders ([Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-carbon/)). Several posts here are from Arena tests before that post. When the author says the checkpoint was still labeled Gemini 4 Argon, the entry says so. A display name is the author's report, not an independent check of the backend.

The text of this list is [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE). Prompts and creations stay with their authors.

## How to add one

1. Add one public creation to [`data/entries.yml`](data/entries.yml): the author's post, the prompt as they published it, their name, and the date.
2. Run `python3 scripts/build_readme.py` and include the regenerated README and card.
3. Open a pull request. The checks confirm the post, the date, and that the prompt is on the post.

Rules, the entry format, and what to leave out: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## How this list was made

This list was assembled by an AI agent and is human-curated via pull requests. For this first version, the agent checked each public post — author, date, and the prompt text on the post — on 2026-10-29. A person reviews what lands through a PR.

Posts that show a result and never print the prompt are not listed. [@thtbee_](https://x.com/thtbee_)'s [mechanical flower](https://x.com/thtbee_/status/2112935205703147750) describes a Three.js scene and says the bee was not in the prompt, but does not quote the prompt. [@LuminaBench](https://x.com/LuminaBench)'s [Super Mario post](https://x.com/LuminaBench/status/2112848294581813473) refers to "the Super Mario prompt" and does not quote it. Descriptions such as "I asked it to build…" were not copied in as if they were the prompt. No prompt in this file was written by the list.

X pages often block anonymous clients. Lychee skips those URLs. [`scripts/check_x_posts.py`](scripts/check_x_posts.py) reads each status from a public post API and checks the handle, the UTC date, and the prompt text. The exception list is in [`lychee.toml`](lychee.toml).
